raw.title: Fashion Design to UX Design Career Changer
raw.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts across teams

  • Ability to collaborate and executing within a fast-paced engineering team with agile dev sprints

  • Flexibility to adapt quickly to new problems and learn new skills fast. We have a diverse microservices based architecture, and continuously encounter new and exciting engineering problems!

  • Extensive experience with Typescript, NodeJS, MongoDB. React/Angular experience is a plus

  • Ability to conduct peer code reviews of fellow developers in the Full Stack Engineering team

  • Strong experience with testing and growing the system test suite

  • Exposure to elastic search, Redis, Kubernetes, Google cloud

Desired Experience:

  • Exposure to building and scaling products in a fast paced environment

  • 6+years of experience in system design and software development in backend systems

We are looking for trailblazers who love challenging problems because those are the ones worth solving. You will be successful at DOZR if you have:

  • Relentless passion for learning

  • Obsession towards building high quality products, strategy and processes

  • A mind set to build long-term scalable solutions

  • Value data-driven decisions

  • Care deeply about your team members and culture

Please note that this is a remote position and we are considering all applicants.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Benefits:

  • Remote work
  • Casual dress
  • Dental care
  • Extended health care
  • On-site parking
  • Stock options

DOZR has been certified as a Great Place to Work®.

DOZR is transforming the $60 billion equipment rental industry. Every road, hospital, school, home and rocket that is built needs equipment, but there are a lot of challenges that currently exist when renting, maintaining and managing that equipment. We have set out to change that!

DOZR is an online marketplace for heavy equipment. Our platform helps people find equipment rentals anywhere, anytime, and instantly compares pricing across thousands of equipment suppliers across North America.

We are passionate about thinking big and solving complex problems. Founded in 2015, we are a mission-driven, well-funded, fast growing startup, backed by industry experts and leading VCs.

We are expanding quickly and looking for talented people to join our team!

We aim to eliminate the lack of capital as a barrier to business growth. We make a significant impact on small business owners and founders by funding their businesses, transforming their lives and the countless lives in the communities surrounding these businesses.

Our vision is to build a consulting firm-style company that delivers expertise at eye level with C-Level executives and business owner clients.

Tasks

The Role

  • Close warm and pre-qualified leads from Zoom calls booked on your calendar
  • Follow a proven sales script while keeping a natural, conversational tone
  • Understand client needs and offer the best solution to help them succeed
  • Do outbound calls during no-shows
  • Update CRM notes and report daily sales activities
  • Collaborate with our marketing and fulfillment teams to improve conversion rates

Tools: Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, GoHighLevel

What Success Looks Like

  • 25%+ close rate on qualified leads
  • Daily call review of your own calls
  • Reporting is completed end of day without external accountability

Requirements

Your Background:

  • 2+ years of experience in business funding consulting or credit stacking OR
  • 2+ years of experience in a high-ticket, remote closing position in a fast-paced environment

Important values that you share with us:

  • Ownership: Take full responsibility, proactively, always.
  • Integrity: Do the right thing, no matter what.
  • Perseverance: Raise the standard - especially when it gets hard.
  • Innovation: Adapt and grow to become smarter, happier, and more successful.
  • Humility: Care about growth and your team more than about being right.

If these don’t describe you, this won’t be a fit.

This Role is NO FIT if:

  • You want a cushy, comfortable corporate sales job to pay your bills - this is commission-only
  • You are the kind of person who is constantly overwhelmed with life.
  • You are an offer-jumper who switches jobs at the first resistance or feedback.

Availability:

  • 40 or more hours per week from Monday to Friday (weekends optional)

  • Base commission: 20% on a $2.5k - $9k price point
  • Milestone bonuses: Commission increases up to 35% for all units of a month if you hit your milestones.
  • OTE (8 hrs call time / 5 days a week / 29% avg. close rate): $20,300 per month

Commission-only — but with stacked calendars + daily inbound leads. Your earning potential is capped only by discipline & skill.

Work Benefits:

  • You are selling a service that actually changes lives with a professional fulfillment team in the background that is fully committed and taking care of every client.
  • Seamless reporting - yes, reporting is required, but we’ve reduced it to 15 minutes per day.
  • Daily inbound leads and stacked calendars - we flood you with opportunity.
  • Weekly coaching and call reviews with our founder
  • A fun culture where we are a team instead of big egos working against each other.

Other Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work in U.S. hours
  • W-2 conversion possible after 6 months (first 6 months will be 1099 / contract)
  • MBA-level finance & consulting education
  • Leadership track in under 2 years available with the right personal growth
  • Company offsites

How to Apply

If you’re ready to own outcomes, raise the standard, and help build an empire, we’d love to meet you!

Please send us:

  • An updated CV (resume)
  • A 2-3 min video explaining your honest, personal motivation for this position - why do you think this position aligns with your personal goals and life situation?

From there, the process will continue with:

  • A group interview
  • A 1-on-1 interview with Sam (Founder)

raw.title: Mobile UI Designer
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

raw.description:
En Scalta Arquitectura, un Responsable de Diseño y Desarrollo Técnico de un proyecto desempeña un papel clave en el proceso de concepción, diseño y ejecución de proyectos arquitectónicos, así como en el seguimiento de sus obras. Desempeñando este puesto te encargarás de ejecutar todas las fases tanto de diseño como técnicas, desde la identificación de parcelas hasta la supervisión de la construcción, asegurando el cumplimiento de normativas y la satisfacción del cliente, a quien atenderás de forma directa. Buscamos un perfil con altas capacidad de trabajo en equipo y de comunicación efectiva con clientes, aparejadores, constructores y técnicos municipales.

Tareas

  • Evaluar y analizar las parcelas de nuevos proyectos (análisis topográfico y geotécnico).
  • Investigar y comprender las normativas de construcción locales y regionales.
  • Desarrollar los primeros planos, incorporando las preferencias del cliente y asegurando viabilidad técnica.
  • Desarrollar el diseño, realizando ajustes según las necesidades del cliente y las restricciones normativas.
  • Crear infografías 3D realistas para visualizar el diseño propuesto.
  • Revisar y discutir las infografías con el cliente para obtener su aprobación.
  • Elaborar el proyecto de ejecución completo una vez que el diseño esté 100% definido.
  • Realizar los cálculos de estructuras, diseño de instalaciones, delineación, memorias y elaboración de mediciones para incorporarlos al proyecto de ejecución.
  • Coordinar trámites con los Colegios de Arquitectos y Ayuntamientos.
  • Gestionar la obtención de todos los permisos necesarios para iniciar la construcción.
  • Seguimiento a la ejecución de la obra durante la fase de construcción.
  • Resolver problemas técnicos que surjan durante la construcción y ajustar el diseño cuando sea necesario.

Requisitos

Titulación exigida: No se define una titulación mínima exigida; podrán optar al puesto todas aquellas personas con capacidades para desarrollar las tareas detalladas.

Experiencia: Experiencia mínima demostrable de 3 años.

Lugar de residencia: Residencia demostrable en un radio aproximado de 100 km hasta Tres Cantos.

Coche propio: Necesario.

Beneficios

Tipología de contrato: Indefinido.

Jornada: Completa.

Modalidad de trabajo: Teletrabajo.

Salario: Horquilla salarial a definirse según experiencia entre 26.000 y 35.000€ brutos anuales.

Horario: De Lunes a Viernes de 7:30h-15:30h.

raw.title: Investment Principal - Growth Equity
raw.excerpt: We’re hiring a Principal to play a central role in building and scaling a high-performing investment platform.
raw.description:
We’re hiring a Principal to play a central role in building and scaling a high-performing investment platform. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an investor who wants real ownership—of deals, outcomes, and the long-term success of the firm.

As a Principal, you will sit at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You will lead investments from origination through exit, work closely with co-founders, the CFO, and investment colleagues to drive aligned execution, and help shape the firm’s investment culture and portfolio.

Your Northstar is to drive exceptional returns for our shareholders.

You want your career to move the needle for the planet. You are:

  • An experienced investor with a strong track record in private equity / growth equity with climate / cleantech exposure (i.e. worked on 10+ deals end to end).

  • A rigorous thinker with excellent financial, analytical, and judgment skills. An advanced degree (PhD or similar) is highly regarded, particularly if it allows you to de-risk emerging technologies through a technical lens.

  • A trusted partner to management teams who balances ambition with discipline

  • A direct, thoughtful and collaborative leader who combines high standards with low ego

  • Motivated by ownership, responsibility, and building something enduring

You are attracted by the opportunity to redefine venture investing and significantly accelerate the transition to a more sustainable world. We look for someone who sees obstacles as opportunities and doesn’t take no for an answer. And has fun doing it 🙂

Diverse teams perform better. Please bring your differences along.

Rypples is a permanent-capital platform built by two unicorn founders on a mission to accelerate the scaling of ocean-positive solutions by re-inventing venture impact investing.

In the Grey to Green transition, we need purpose-built capital solutions to actually bring innovation to scale. Unfortunately, closed-end VC funds optimize for short cycles and power law while lenders and institutional investors are out of reach for growth stage companies. That gap between venture dreamers and debt realists is called the “valley of death”. We think of it as a structural inefficiency and an opportunity to generate significant alpha.

Rypples is not a fund but an operating holding company, investing out of balance sheet with the flexible mandate and founder-operator experience to support companies and drive execution excellence from early growth stage through to scale.

In the last 12 months, we have already invested in 10 amazing companies across five verticals (Ocean Health, Ecosystems, Data, Maritime and Blue Foods). In ten years, Rypples will have successfully deployed $1bn into 100 ocean positive solutions and established a new capital model for scaling impactful innovation.

raw.description:
Poniżej opis najważniejszych obowiązków i wyzwań, które na Ciebie czekają na tym stanowisku:

  • Rozrysowywanie lejków sprzedażowych oraz koordynowaniu zadań reszty zespołu w celu osiągnięcia celów sprzedaży. Będziesz blisko współpracować z zespołem social media.
  • Testowanie wielu metod sprzedaży zaczynając od cold mailingu, cold callingu, LinkedIn prospectingu a kończąc na live'ach i webinarach sprzedażowych*.

* Nie będziemy wymagać byś występował na e-scenie - spokojnie :) No, chyba że będziesz miał duże parcie na szkło :P

  • Skutecznie mierzenie rezultatów i wdrażanie zmian w planie sprzedażowym jeśli będzie to konieczne.
  • Budowanie społeczności oraz pozyskiwanie leadów i potencjalnych klientów (przy współpracy z działem marketingu i social media)
  • Planowanie, wdrażanie i analiza działań mających na celu przekuć naszych fanów w klientów, którzy korzystają z naszych usług.

Czego oczekujemy?

  • Zapału i chęci ciągłego samorozwoju
  • Doświadczenie w sprzedaży lub marketingu mile widziane, ale niekonieczne
  • Przede wszystkim zainteresowania sprzedażą i pozyskiwaniem klientów.

Czas trwania stażu: 3 miesiące (staż jest bezpłatny). No chyba, że zaczniesz generować takie wyniki, że chętnie oddamy Ci procent z wygenerowanych sprzedaży.

Godziny: 20-25h w tygodniu - konkretne godziny pracy do ustalenia.

Czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie? Aplikuj już teraz, by nikt inny Cię nie ubiegł i rozwijaj się z nami.

Wyślij nam swoje CV oraz wyjaśnij dlaczego powinniśmy wybrać właśnie Ciebie, dołączając krótką prezentację o sobie w formie video.

Howgh!

Fascynuje Cię świat sprzedaży i chciałbyś się nauczyć jak sprzedawać w świecie cyfrowym?

A może chcesz w przyszłości otworzyć swój biznes? Jeśli tak to jedno jest pewnie - bez skilli sprzedażowych raczej będzie ciężko.

Ale na szczęście możesz uczyć się od tych, którzy już zajmują się tym od dłuższego czasu i pokażą Ci jak wdrożyć nowy produkt i zacząć generować sprzedaż od zera.

W balanGO ruszyła właśnie rekrutacja na Rekina Sprzedaży dla naszej nowej marki w branży edukacji online. Nie, nie musisz mieć doświadczenia - to bierzemy na siebie. Od Ciebie wystarczą tylko szczere chęci, max zaangażowania oraz chęć zdobycia wszystkich niezbędnych umiejętności by stać się w pełni samodzielną osobą na tym stanowisku z końcem Twojego stażu.

Oczywiście odpowiednio Cię wyszkolimy i damy wszystkie potrzebne narzędzia byś po ukończeniu stażu wiedział w jaki sposób układać lejki sprzedażowe, sprzedawać produkty cyfrowy różnymi kanałami i wykorzystywać przy tym automatyzacje, które zaoszczędzą Twój czas. Czyli w skrócie, staniesz się z nami skutecznym e-handlowcem, który będzie realizować cele sprzedażowe.
